summary: Air T Funding filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to 320,000 shares of 8% Alpha Income Trust Preferred Securities (liquidation amount $25/share), with aggregate proceeds of $8 million. The offering is through sales agent Ascendiant Capital Markets, LLC on NASDAQ (symbol AIRTP). The last reported price was $19.63 on July 6, 2026. This is a routine capital raise via an ATM facility, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing continues an existing shelf registration and does not involve a fundamental corporate change or strategic event.
